name: mark.system
shortDescription: Mark current system on map and add short note to logbook
description: This plugin adds a mission to the job board allowing the user to mark current planet on map and add a short pager-like note to the logbook, selected from a pre-established list. Marks are removed by cancelling corresponding mission, and notes are erased once all marks have been cleared. Meanwhile, an "obsolescence marker note" is added to logbook.
